title: The song he hums
summary: The kit man hums the same tune every time the kit's in a state. It was his wife's. A season on, before a big game, you can get it played at the ground.

ends.title: Her song
ends.text: They played his wife's song at the ground before kick-off, and he heard it from the tunnel.

ends.title: In the kit room
ends.text: He still hums it, and only in the kit room.

beats.title: The song he hums

event.title: The song he hums
event.speaker: kitman
setup: The kit room after a wet Saturday. Twenty muddy shirts on the floor and {kitman.short} is humming the same tune he always hums, over and over.

say: He sees you listening. "My wife's. We had it at the wedding and we had it at the funeral. I hum it when the kit's in a mess. Keeps me calm."

replies.label: Pick up a shirt and start folding.

say: "Forty-one years. She came to every home game and she never once knew the score. She came for the pies and the singing."

replies.label: Pick up a shirt and start folding.

folded.text: You fold badly and he redoes every one of them behind you. He hums the whole song twice and tells you her name.

left.text: He goes back to humming. You can hear it from the corridor.

beats.hint: The kit man is humming again

beats.title: The record

event.title: The record
event.speaker: kitman
setup: {kitman.short} has brought in an old record in a paper sleeve and propped it on the shelf by the kettle. Her song. The sleeve has a coffee ring on it and a date in pencil.

say: "Found it in the loft. Don't know what to do with it. Haven't got anything to play it on."

replies.label: Find a record player and bring it in.

play.text: You find one at a car boot for six pounds. He plays it once, on his own, with the kit room door shut.

frame.text: He frames the sleeve and hangs it by the kettle.

beats.hint: The kit man has brought something in

beats.title: Before kick-off

event.title: Before kick-off
event.speaker: kitman
setup: A season on, a cup night at home. The stadium announcer is in the tunnel with a clipboard, asking if anyone has a song for the warm-up.
{if arc.path=='folded'}You know the name of the song. You know hers too.{/if}
{if arc.deep=='play'}The record player from the car boot is still in the kit room.{/if}

choices.label: Ask for the kit man's song.

outcomes.text: It comes on as you walk out for the warm-up. {kitman.short} stops at the end of the tunnel with a towel over his shoulder and stands there until it finishes.
They play the usual. In the kit room at full time he's humming his own.

beats.hint: A season on, there's a big game at home
